test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique number that is issued by the _______.

options.text: Unique Indian Digital Authority of India
Unique Indian Demographic Association of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Unique Identification Authority of India.**__

__
 
• The **Unique Identification Authority of India's** objective is to collect the biometric and demographic data of residents, store them in a centralized database, and issue a 12-digit unique identity number called Aadhaar to each resident. 
 
• It is considered the** world's largest national identification number project. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)** is a statutory authority established on **12 July 2016** by the Government of India under the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, **under the provisions of the **Aadhaar Act 2016.**
 
• On **July 19, 2017 **it launched the mAadhaar app for Android.
 
• With the mAadhaar app, users will be able to get the updated view of the profile upon completion of the update request and they will even be able to share QR code and password protected eKYC data to retrieve accurate demographic information from it instead of manual entry.
